prompt: Match each Fastlane action to what it does.

pairs.right: fetches the team's certificates and profiles
sends a bundle and the listing to a Play track
archives and exports an iOS build

right_distractors: re-signs an APK with Google's key

prompt: What does the lesson give as Fastlane's advantage over a plain shell script?

choices.text: It needs no credentials to reach either store
choices.why: Store actions need API keys.

choices.text: It builds faster than calling Gradle and Xcode directly
choices.why: It calls the same Gradle and Xcode.

choices.text: Store actions, the listing layout, portable lanes
choices.why: Right. Those three, in the lesson's words.

choices.text: It replaces review
choices.why: Nothing replaces review.

prompt: A React Native team uses Fastlane. How is its Fastfile organised?

choices.text: One file with a platform block per store
choices.why: Right. platform :android and platform :ios.

choices.text: Two repositories, one per platform
choices.why: One project, one Fastfile.

choices.text: A JavaScript Fastfile that Expo translates
choices.why: Fastfiles are Ruby.

choices.text: None: Fastlane does not support React Native
choices.why: It works on the native projects React Native produces.

prompt: Why is Fastlane installed with Bundler into `vendor/bundle`, and run with `bundle exec`?

choices.text: Because Ruby cannot install gems globally
choices.why: It can; that is what the lesson avoids.

choices.text: The stores require it
choices.why: The stores do not know how Fastlane was installed.

choices.text: Bundler makes Fastlane faster
choices.why: Speed is not the reason.

choices.text: To pin its version
choices.why: Right. Each project pins its own: two projects, two versions, no conflict.

prompt: The environment variable that stops Fastlane sending anonymous usage data is `FASTLANE_OPT_OUT____`.
Which file does the lesson say to commit, and which to keep out of git?

choices.text: Commit vendor/bundle; ignore Gemfile.lock
choices.why: The other way round.

choices.text: Commit Gemfile.lock; ignore vendor/bundle
choices.why: Right. The lockfile is lesson 10's cache key for the Ruby side.

choices.text: Commit both, for a reproducible build
choices.why: vendor/bundle is a hundred gems the lockfile already pins.

choices.text: Ignore both; CI installs whatever is newest
choices.why: Then CI and laptops drift apart.

prompt: The `checks` lane runs `sh("cd .. && node preflight.ts")`. Why the `cd ..`?

choices.text: Node refuses to run inside a folder named fastlane
choices.why: Node does not care about the folder's name.

choices.text: Lanes run from inside fastlane/
choices.why: Right. preflight.ts is in the project folder above it.

choices.text: sh needs an absolute path
choices.why: It ran with a relative one.

choices.text: To leave the vendor folder
choices.why: The lane does not run in vendor.

prompt: `bundle exec fastlane lanes` listed `ios beta` on a Linux computer. Why could it, when the iOS lane needs Xcode?

choices.text: Fastlane emulates Xcode on Linux
choices.why: It does not, and cannot.

choices.text: The lane is skipped silently on Linux
choices.why: It was listed, not run or skipped.

choices.text: match downloaded a Mac image
choices.why: match fetches certificates, not machines.

choices.text: Listing reads the file; it runs no lane
choices.why: Right. Running beta would fail at build_app.

prompt: Why does the `internal` lane use `ENV.fetch("AAB")` rather than `ENV["AAB"]`?

choices.text: It refuses to start when the variable is missing
choices.why: Right. ENV[...] would hand the action nothing, in silence.

choices.text: fetch downloads the bundle from CI
choices.why: It reads a variable; it downloads nothing.

choices.text: ENV[...] does not work in Fastfiles
choices.why: It works; it just does not complain.

choices.text: fetch encrypts the value before the action sees it
choices.why: Nothing is encrypted.

prompt: What exit status did Fastlane return when the `checks` lane stopped?
What credential does `upload_to_play_store` use to reach Google Play?

choices.text: The account owner's Google password
choices.why: Store actions never use a person's password.

choices.text: The upload keystore
choices.why: That signs the bundle; it does not log in.

choices.text: A service account key, as JSON
choices.why: Right. With the least permissions that do the job.

choices.text: A .p8 key from App Store Connect
choices.why: That is Apple's.

prompt: Lesson 4 kept the listing in `listing/android/en-US/title.txt` and friends. What does Fastlane's upload need beyond that?

choices.text: A changelogs folder
choices.why: Right. Release notes named by version code.

choices.text: A copy for every country, not per language
choices.why: Folders are per language.

choices.text: Nothing; it cannot read that folder
choices.why: It reads exactly that layout.

choices.text: The files converted to JSON
choices.why: It reads the text files as they are.

prompt: In the `promote` lane, why is the target track called `alpha`?

choices.text: Alpha is a fifth track above production
choices.why: There is no track above production.

choices.text: It is the name of the planner's first release
choices.why: Track names are the store's.

choices.text: Google's API names the closed track alpha
choices.why: Right. And the open track beta.

choices.text: Fastlane renames tracks
choices.why: It uses the API's names.

prompt: Put the steps of the iOS `beta` lane in order.
A team's lane uploads first and runs its checks after. What is wrong with that order?

choices.text: Nothing, as long as both run
choices.why: A failed check after upload stops nothing.

choices.text: It ships before any check stops it
choices.why: Right. The release reaches the store first; the gate goes first instead.

choices.text: Fastlane refuses to upload before sh
choices.why: It runs actions in the order written.

choices.text: Checks take too long after an upload
choices.why: Time is not the problem.

prompt: Which of these ran for real in this lesson? Choose every one.

choices.text: bundle exec fastlane --version
choices.why: Right.

choices.text: bundle exec fastlane lanes
choices.why: Right.

choices.text: bundle exec fastlane checks
choices.why: Right.

choices.text: bundle exec fastlane ios beta
choices.why: It needs a Mac and an Apple account.
